name: 24315 · Bland, VA
findings: ZIP 24315 (Bland) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (89% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24315 (Bland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
